author: minertedtoad
body:
Who you want to address the question (Can be addressed by a whole group or one specific Senior Staff member); All
Question; why am i not allowed to play the walls on a day I want to.

Today I decided to have a nice game on the walls when I was told that I couldn't because of a tournament. First of all any tournament should be done on events not a public server. Secondly why should we have to put up with having a server which we can't play on. Also where was the prior warning that the walls would be used to have a tournament. I feel disgusted that this has happened and in future I would like to see this tournament happen on events not a public server.
